definitions.explanation: A third molar tooth, the last teeth to emerge in the back of the mouth, typically appearing in late adolescence or early adulthood. Often associated with dental problems requiring extraction.

examples.japanese: {親知|おやし}らず⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}えて→生える：02392_haeru⟧きた。
examples.english: My wisdom tooth is coming in.

examples.japanese: {親知|おやし}らず⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}いて→抜く：02384_nuku⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my wisdom tooth pulled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{親知|おやし}らず⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{横向|よこむ}き→横向き：17271_yokomuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|は}えていて→生える：02392_haeru⟧、⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: My lower wisdom tooth is growing in sideways and it hurts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歯医者|はいしゃ}→歯医者：01696_haisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{親知|おやし}らず⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{抜歯|ばっし}→抜歯：21278_basshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勧|すす}められた→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{怖|こわ}くて→怖い：00864_kowai⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{決|き}められない→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: The dentist recommended extracting my wisdom tooth, but I'm scared and can't decide yet.

notes:
Literally "⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧" — "the tooth the parent doesn't know about," because wisdom teeth emerge after a child has grown up and left parental oversight. This folk etymology gives the word a distinctly Japanese flavor compared to the English "wisdom tooth" (which emphasizes the age of wisdom).

Wisdom tooth extraction ({親知|おやし}らず⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{抜歯|ばっし}→抜歯：21278_basshi⟧) is a common topic of conversation in Japan, as with many cultures. The teeth frequently cause problems by growing in at an angle (⟦{横向|よこむ}き→横向き：17271_yokomuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|は}える→生える：02392_haeru⟧) or becoming impacted.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {親知|おやし}らず⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧: to extract a wisdom tooth
- {親知|おやし}らず⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}える→生える：02392_haeru⟧: a wisdom tooth comes in
- {親知|おやし}らず⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: one's wisdom tooth hurts
- {親知|おやし}らず⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{抜歯|ばっし}→抜歯：21278_basshi⟧: wisdom tooth extraction
- ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{親知|おやし}らず / ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{親知|おやし}らず: upper / lower wisdom tooth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {奥歯|おくば}: back tooth, molar — a broader term for any molar, not just wisdom teeth
- {乳歯|にゅうし}: baby tooth, milk tooth — the teeth that fall out in childhood, a different stage of dental development
- {永久歯|えいきゅうし}: permanent tooth — the adult teeth that replace baby teeth
